paragraphs: Delivering comprehensive dental care to High Point in a compassionate, considerate, and respectful manner.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.
Comprehensive dental care for every member of your family. From routine cleanings to advanced treatments, we provide exceptional care with the latest technology and techniques.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.

You’ll find Riccobene Family Dentistry just west of Greensboro in beautiful High Point, NC. Our modern, comfortable facilities are just off NC-68 and convenient to I40. Dentistry isn’t just a job for the staff at Riccobene Family Dentistry, it is a passion that we bring to the High Point community.

25 years of experience have taught us what it takes to serve our community with excellence, and you’ll immediately notice what sets us apart - caring, compassionate and comprehensive dental care delivered by members of your community. We don’t just work in and around our High Point office, we live here - so for us, smiles are personal.
We believe in the Riccobene Way - a commitment to deliver better dentistry, better experiences and better results with a comprehensive and compassionate approach.
When you help a lot of people you get to some large numbers that we’re proud of - each satisfied patient is another happy smile.
Can't make it to our High Point office? We have other convenient locations in the area to serve you with the same exceptional dental care.
Quality dental care should be accessible to everyone. We offer flexible payment options, accept most insurance plans, and provide affordable membership plans for uninsured patients.
Save money on dental care with our affordable annual membership plans. No insurance? No problem! Get the care you need at a price you can afford.
Yes, Riccobene Family Dentistry in High Point, NC is accepting new patients today. Give us a call or fill out the information below to book a new patient appointment today.

Yes, we provide emergency dental care in High Point, NC. We make every effort to accommodate emergencies same-day or next-day, or if it's convenient to visit one of our other locations in the area, we can help direct you to our nearest location for urgent dental needs.

Professional teeth whitening is one of the most common cosmetic dental procedures we see here at Riccobene in High Point. In as little as one visit, you can whiten and brighten your smile. Give us a call today to schedule a consultation.

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Prior to any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.

Twice a year hygiene appointments are part of a healthy dental routine, and are the minimum we recommend. Depending on your dental needs, we may recommend extra visits if you’re working with us to solve more complex dental problems or improve your smile.

Give us a call, send us a message, or book an appointment online - however you prefer to book, we can get you on the schedule and into the office on a schedule that works for you. We look forward to seeing you at our High Point, NC location!
Take the first step towards optimal oral health. Contact our High Point office to schedule your appointment or ask any questions about our dental services.
Fill out the form below and we'll get back to you within 24 hours.

Call our High Point  Office at 336-841-0000, or use the form below to request an appointment.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Are you accepting new patients at your High Point location?

Yes, Riccobene Family Dentistry in High Point, NC is accepting new patients today. Give us a call or fill out the information below to book a new patient appointment today.

Do you provide emergency dental care in High Point, NC?

Yes, we provide emergency dental care in High Point, NC. We make every effort to accommodate emergencies same-day or next-day, or if it's convenient to visit one of our other locations in the area, we can help direct you to our nearest location for urgent dental needs.

Can I get professional teeth whitening at your High Point office?

Professional teeth whitening is one of the most common cosmetic dental procedures we see here at Riccobene in High Point. In as little as one visit, you can whiten and brighten your smile. Give us a call today to schedule a consultation.

Do you accept dental insurance at your High Point dental office?

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Prior to any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.

How often should I schedule a dental checkup in your High Point office?

Twice a year hygiene appointments are part of a healthy dental routine, and are the minimum we recommend. Depending on your dental needs, we may recommend extra visits if you’re working with us to solve more complex dental problems or improve your smile.

How do I schedule an appointment at Riccobene Associates in High Point?

Give us a call, send us a message, or book an appointment online - however you prefer to book, we can get you on the schedule and into the office on a schedule that works for you. We look forward to seeing you at our High Point, NC location!
